releaseNotes: 📱 Universal Responsive UI Scaling: Automatic proportional scaling across all Android screen sizes and display zoom levels.
🖼️ Refined Photo Grid & Media Vault: Balanced 3-column square photo tiles with compact non-overlapping badges and reorder controls.
⚡ Seamless Listing Cache & Switching: Fixed image cross-contamination when switching between My Listings and All Listings.
🔢 Contextual Listing Counters: Added clear filtered count display matching segment totals.
🌐 Full Bilingual Navigation: Seamless language switching across listing creation, editing, and review steps.
📸 Streamlined 2-Option Share Sheet: Share multi-photo albums with live download progress.
💡 Universal Android Guidance: Send clean albums with auto-caption without repeated text on all Android brands.
📋 1-Tap Copywriting: Instant copy with price/sqft and monthly loan estimates.
🔔 Notifications Inbox: View all past agency announcements anytime from the new bell icon on your Dashboard.
📲 Direct Phone Notifications: Receive important announcements directly in your phone notification center.
🌐 Language Matching: Announcements now seamlessly adapt to your preferred language (English / Bahasa Melayu).
✨ Smarter Dashboard: Dismissed announcement banners stay closed permanently with zero startup flash.
Fixed AuthGuard cold-start: App strictly returns to login after signing out.
Added [← Sign In] back button on registration screen.
Full multi-language support (English & Bahasa Melayu) on Login & Register.
Enhanced registration reliability with automatic Firestore user database sync.
Redesigned App Updates page: Consolidated hero status, removed cache clutter, and added Android install permission tips.
Collapsible Release History accordions with easy changelog browsing.
Unified 3-Step Listing Wizard with interactive GPS geocoding & address sync.
Interactive 'Locate Me' GPS button on Master Map View.
Clean Active listing feed default with human-readable date recency badges.
Posted date display on Property Detail page.
Fluid motion and snappy, zero-bounce transitions across tabs and cards.
Fixed sold status badge icon and improved multi-photo WhatsApp sharing.
Fixed MapView UI overlapping with FAB and Android navigation buttons.
Added Interactive Map Location Picker for new listings.
Added automatic parsing of Google Maps and Waze URLs.
Fixed overlapping UI issues across the app.
Fixed navigation bar overlap on 3-button navigation devices.
Improved Firestore realtime listener stability and memory efficiency.
Search filter null-safety and stability improvements.
Bug fixes and stability improvements.
Fixed navigation bar theming and layout.
Improved Loan Calculator and Listing creation flows.
Refined Multi-Photo WhatsApp Sharing: Enhanced photo gallery preparation and formatted caption attachment.
Adaptive Light & Dark Mode Navigation Dock: Dynamic background and active highlight switching.
Android 3-Button Navigation Bar Clearance: Bottom sheet modals now have full clearance above Back/Home/Recents buttons.
Seamless In-App APK Updater with automatic storage cache cleanup.
